acceptedAnswer.text: When choosing an insulation contractor, look for experience, proper licensing, and insurance. Check their reputation through online reviews and ask for references. A reliable contractor should offer a thorough inspection of your home, provide detailed estimates, explain different insulation options, and be transparent about the process. Ensure they understand local building codes and can offer solutions tailored to the specific climate and housing styles common in areas like Mission Viejo and Lake Forest.
